project.name: 单股分析界面
project.styleDefinitionBrief: Finance SaaS dashboard, cool neutral + emerald green accent, Inter + Noto Sans SC, card-based layout with data-dense panels, restrained surfaces with subtle borders.
project.designRead: Stock analysis dashboard / retail+pro investors / calm data-driven trust / medium-high density / avoid purple neon AI hero

colorSystem.primaryColorRole: single emerald brand hue used for primary CTA, selected states, and positive indicators
colorSystem.brandHuePolicy: free-explore uses no secondary/accent brand hue; identities/categories use neutral or primary tints
colorSystem.stateColors: success=green for price up, error=red for price down, warning=amber, info=blue for informational

styleContinuityAnchors.shapeSystem: restrained radius scale: 4px/8px/12px/full; cards use 8px, buttons use 8px, inputs use 8px
styleContinuityAnchors.typographySystem: Inter + Noto Sans SC for all text; JetBrains Mono for prices/numbers; size scale 11-30px; weight 400/500/600/700
styleContinuityAnchors.spacingSystem: 4px base grid; card padding 20-24px; section gap 24px; page padding 32px
styleContinuityAnchors.componentLanguage: border-first cards with minimal shadow (alpha<=0.05); subtle surface layering; compact data tables
styleContinuityAnchors.surfaceAndDepth: static surfaces use border-only; floating layers (modal/dropdown) use shadow with alpha<=0.12
styleContinuityAnchors.imageryAndIconography: CSS charts via Chart.js; icons inline SVG or CSS; no decorative images needed
styleContinuityAnchors.interactionTone: subtle hover transitions (150-200ms); no aggressive animations; functional micro-feedback only

sharedProjectShellContract.navigationShell: left sidebar with app logo + nav items (仪表盘/分析结果/历史); active item highlighted with brand color bg pill; 240px fixed width
sharedProjectShellContract.primaryColorSystem: single emerald brand hue #0D9373; no secondary/accent brand color
sharedProjectShellContract.typographySystem: Inter + Noto Sans SC; mono for numbers; size scale 11-30px
sharedProjectShellContract.surfaceDepthModel: border-only for static; shadow<=0.12 alpha for floating layers
sharedProjectShellContract.ctaStyle: brand bg color, white text, 8px radius, medium font-weight, subtle hover transition
sharedProjectShellContract.alignmentRules: left-aligned content within cards; numeric data right-aligned; centered page title in topbar

designSource.designDecisionSummary: Cool neutral palette with emerald green (#0D9373) accent; Inter + Noto Sans SC typography; restrained 8px radius cards with border-first depth; compact data density for financial dashboard

pages.title: 分析仪表盘
pages.businessScenario: Main entry point showing stock search, market overview, recent analyses, and quick-start analysis controls
pages.visualNorthStar: Clean data-focused dashboard with a prominent stock search bar at top, followed by key market stats cards and a recent analysis list; information-dense but well-organized with card sections
pages.compositionPattern: Dashboard grid: search-first hero strip + 2-column KPI cards + 3-column recent analysis table
qualityRisks: high data density in first screen
CJK title wrapping in narrow cards

pages.title: 分析结果
pages.businessScenario: Full single-stock analysis result showing scores, price charts, AI-generated summaries, and detailed analysis sections
pages.visualNorthStar: Comprehensive analysis page with a stock identity header strip (price, change, basic info), followed by score gauges, a large price chart, and tabbed detailed analysis sections below
pages.compositionPattern: Identity header + score cards row + large chart panel + tabbed analysis sections (technical/fundamental/sentiment/risk)
qualityRisks: multiple chart types on one page
